fieldguide.block.wetland_whimsy.aria_mus: Small mushrooms that cling to Bald Cypress trees.
fieldguide.block.wetland_whimsy.aria_spo: Spores of the Aria Mushroom, ready to sprout tall into a towering fungus.
fieldguide.block.wetland_whimsy.bald_cyp: The sapling of a Bald Cypress tree.
A tree native to marshes and swamps. Its wood is purple in color.
fieldguide.block.wetland_whimsy.cordgras: Thick, tall grass native to marshes and swamps.
fieldguide.block.wetland_whimsy.fellcap_: Fungus that grows across the world and in caves. Stepping on it releases poisonous gas.
fieldguide.block.wetland_whimsy.huge_ari: A huge Aria Mushroom, dappled around forested and swampy areas. Its flesh is bouncy!
fieldguide.block.wetland_whimsy.pennywor: Small, floating, lilypad-like plants. It is quite tasty in salads.
fieldguide.entity.wetland_whimsy.crane.d: Flying passive mobs that love beetroot seeds and drop feathers.
fieldguide.entity.wetland_whimsy.crawfis: Small passive mobs that hang out on the bottom of riverbeds and lakes. They are a delicious additional to any meal.
fieldguide.entity.wetland_whimsy.filth.d: Ew, Gross. Maybe this rotting pile of bones and mud could be useful for something.
fieldguide.entity.wetland_whimsy.infecte: A hostile spider, swollen with fellcap spores which it spreads on attack. However, shedding its fungi with shears will prevent this.
